method: JDK javap -p -c -constants; selected .class bytes directly read; no runtime

findings.title: DIMENSION_AGNOSTIC_PROTO_COUNT
findings.detail: SporeSavedData.protos static list is global per JVM; getAmountOfHiveminds returns size, regardless of queried ServerLevel. Per-level setDefaultLinkage/Adaptation checks use this global size against proto_spawn_world_mod (default 3). 2+1 loaded Protos in two dimensions meet threshold even though no dimension has 3, provided SavedData is initialized.

findings.title: CROSS_DIMENSION_TICKET_REPLAY_CANDIDATE
findings.detail: SporeSavedData.activeRequests is static; getRequests returns all; onWorldLoad iterates entries and forceChunk(currentServerLevel,pos) without comparing stored request dimension. World NBT serializer likewise writes static all-requests without per-level filter.

findings.title: DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_CREDIT
findings.detail: Proto.fillDefaultTeams unconditionally shuffles 4 eligible entries and populates each of 4 team lists with exactly 4 slots; summonMob records selected team index j as both decision and member, while actual selected unit index k uniform 0..3; j!=k on 12 of 16 combinations (75%) absent later team mutations.

external_behavior_hint.description: Community wiki claims per-dimension 3-Proto threshold; differs from original JAR counter scope. Do not count guide as direct proof.
